Disable `@WithSpan` instrumentation of Kotlin suspend functions by default for 3.0 because tail-optimized calls can bypass dispatcher interception. Enable it explicitly:

```properties
otel.instrumentation.kotlinx-coroutines-annotations.enabled=true
```

The `kotlinx-coroutines`, `kotlinx-coroutines-1.0`, `kotlinx-coroutines-opentelemetry-instrumentation-annotations`, and `opentelemetry-instrumentation-annotations` selectors no longer enable suspend function annotations. Ordinary coroutine context propagation and `@WithSpan` methods returning `Flow` retain their existing defaults.

Splits the Kotlin changes out of #20428. Includes a disabled regression with an unannotated control demonstrating that an annotated tail call resumes on the callback executor instead of its original dispatcher. This [known issue](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/19446#discussion_r3824285214) remains unfixed.
metadata.title: Disable Kotlin suspend annotations by default
